decisions.finding: Official Dacia Poland current model pages still expose Hybrid 155 for Sandero Expression, Sandero Journey, Sandero Stepway Expression and Sandero Stepway Extreme.

The current Dacia Poland model pages show the same gross starting prices already materialized from the 11.08.2026 price list: Sandero Expression 84,600 PLN; Sandero Journey 90,200 PLN; Stepway Expression 90,700 PLN; Stepway Extreme 96,800 PLN.
decisions.evidence: Current official model pages searched on 2026-09-19.

decisions.finding: The public configurator page is reachable and exposes version/engine/design/equipment sections, but this web session does not provide a reliable reproducible record of every selectable option for each Hybrid 155 configuration. Do not convert the current page's default configuration into master observations.
No current-web observation is being written into the dated 11.08.2026 master dataset merely because it is visible now. Historical source boundaries remain intact.

next_actions: Use an interactive configurator/browser session when available to enumerate Hybrid 155 option states and configuration dependencies.
Reconcile the interactive results against the 11.08.2026 equipment matrix before creating any new master rows.
Keep current-web observations in reporting/provenance unless a dated source establishes their effective date.
